creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers health insurance and care delivery and shows no creative activity ("benefit designs" and "Customer Experience Design" are traps).

community.reason: Level 2: employee education and certification assistance plus a gift-matching program and volunteer time off, all specific but with no reach figures, so external reach is not shown for level 3.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: specific current activities (Medicaid plans for vulnerable populations, the LI-NET low-income access program, an annual pay equity analysis) with no reach figures disclosed alongside the cited text.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: rests only on general language about the company's own innovation and services to providers, with no specific program enabling founders or small businesses.

notes: Medicaid (state-based contracts and other) appears in segment tables elsewhere with $14,477 million revenue (11.2%) and 1,615.6 thousand members. Those figures are not in the same paragraph or table as the descriptive quote, so they were not used as indicators. It is also debatable whether ordinary participation in government-funded Medicaid counts as cross-cultural customer access, since no language, accessibility or cultural barrier-removal features are described. Torn between levels 2 and 3, so the lower level was chosen; suggest human review. The pay equity analysis does not name specific groups. The company has no business line that creates or enables creative work. The human capital section refers to the proxy statement for more detail, but it lists specific activities itself, so coverage is sufficient. The Item 7 excerpts contain only mission language ("communities at large") and a trap use of "education" (municipal bond types), with no qualifying activity. The MSO services to physicians and medical groups were not counted as entrepreneurship enabling: they support value-based care transition, not barriers to starting or growing a business. The paid internship and the employee well-being benefits (including on-site lactation rooms and adoption assistance) were not scored.
